name: morpheus-self-hosted
title: Morpheus — today
lede: Morpheus builds software by describing it, and it builds itself — the planner→coder→reviewer loop is live and shipping 13 native compile targets today.
sub: The results in one read: what actually ships, what is deferred, and what the numbers really are.

nums.label: of AI spend is the build pipeline

real.evidence: planner → coder → reviewer edits real files, then verify → push → watch → revert; main sits at 9e4b863.
/deck and /deck/jarvis, brain-dump auto-filing, long-term memory, cross-deck synthesis, 15 widgets.
public/plugin.js → /embed?token=… — dock loader, plugin source, and the dock the plugin prints for an admin.
android-apk … windows-exe, incl. 3 audio-plugin routes; docs understated them as '6 platforms'.
node scripts/morpheus.mjs whoami|sync|chat|verify|push|merge|smoke — scoped and capped (server/src/lib/operatorToken.js).
main requires guards (no install), lint + build, and render — branch protection, not only merge.js.
meta/Open Graph/JSON-LD, llms.txt, sitemap.xml, robots.txt — index.html 1.5 KB → 16.8 KB.
real token metering, pre-call reserve/reconcile, token blocks, and the live 200-credit signup grant.
dist/portable-morpheus.zip built from the current tree, one-command setup + launchers for macOS/Linux/Windows.

not_built.status: deferred — needs a Morpheus-owned GitHub org and Actions minutes, a fixed cost paid before revenue.
reconnecting buys 7 days then lapses again; the code is fixed (#391) but the consent screen is 'Testing' — a Google Cloud console action.
Marketplace distribution, dynamic widgets and connections, auto-deploy — direction only, not built.
rotation of credentials exposed in early logs accepted as 'cross that bridge later'; operator token revocation UI still owed.

callout: What ships is the self-hosted core — the build loop, the deck, the dock, native compiles. What is deferred sits behind revenue (Priority Compile) or a third-party gate (Google's 7-day wall).
where: The 'digital possibility engine' is the destination, not a shipped feature — Jarvis grows toward dynamic widgets and a Marketplace in the order revenue allows.
